## Simulation experiment 2

### Libraries

```{r}
library(AgeReading)
library(rstan)
library(ggplot2)
require(gridExtra)


```

Load simulation results

```{r}
Amin=3;Amax=12
A = Amax-Amin+1

##Comparing estimated xi^1 with truth
load("../../save_results/Sim2_xi1.RData")              #reader dependent age errors
xi1 = xi1sim

yearstrat = list(y1=c(1:6),y2=c(7:11),y3=c(12:15))
##CRSP:
data(Herring_D_boot)
library(verification)
K=15
crpsxi = array(NA,c(K,A,4))
Dmean = aggregate(Herring_D_boot$Abundance,list(Herring_D_boot$unitstrat),FUN=mean)$x
Ntrue = array(NA,c(3,A))
for(y in 1:3)
{
  Dy = Herring_D_boot[Herring_D_boot$Year==(2020+y),]
  Dmean = aggregate(Dy$Abundance,list(Dy$unitstrat),FUN=mean)$x
  for(a in 1:A)
   Ntrue[y,a] = sum(Dmean*xi1[yearstrat[[y]],a])
}

#Data: M_r: Model:M_r
data(Herring_D_boot)
data(HerringSurvey)

load("../../save_results/sim2fitcomb0M_1.100000.RData")              #reader dependent age errors
foo = rstan::extract(simfitcomb0.year)$xi1
res0 = Make_Numfish_sample(foo,Herring_D_boot,HerringSurvey$stratayearindex)

load("../../save_results/sim2fitcomb1M_indM_1.100000.RData")              #reader dependent age errors
foo = rstan::extract(simfitcomb1.year)$xi1
res1 = Make_Numfish_sample(foo,Herring_D_boot,HerringSurvey$stratayearindex)
```


### Make plot of estimates for xi1

```{r}
l = list()
tit = c("2021,6,3","2021,7,6","2021,8,3","2021,9,2","2021,10,3",
        "2021,12,4","2022,5,1","2022,6,13","2022,7,7","2022,8,6",
        "2022,9,2","2023,5,1","2023,6,10","2023,7,4","2023,8,3")
xi1.est = extract(simfitcomb0.year,pars="xi1")$xi1
for(k in 1:15)
{
  q = apply(xi1.est[,k,],2,quantile,probs=c(0.025,0.5,0.975))
  df = data.frame(age=2+1:A,q1=q[1,],q2=q[2,],q3=q[3,],xi1true=xi1[k,])
  l[[k]] = ggplot(df,aes(age,q2)) + geom_line(colour="red")+
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=q1,ymax=q3),fill="red",alpha=0.2) +
    theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),axis.title.y=element_blank()) + ylim(0,1) +
    geom_line(aes(y=xi1true),show.legend=FALSE)+
    geom_line(aes(colour = "Estimate")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = xi1true, colour = "True")) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      name = NULL,
      values = c(
        "Estimate" = "red",
        "True" = "black"
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.85)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(3, 5, 7, 9, 11)) +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),

      # Show it only on the first panel:
      legend.position = if (k == 1) "inside" else "none",
      legend.position.inside = c(0.98, 0.98),
      legend.justification = c(1, 1),
      # Make the legend compact:
      legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.3, "cm"),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.7, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.05, "cm"),
      legend.background = element_rect(
        fill = "white",
        colour = "black",
        linewidth = 0.2
      ),
      legend.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    ) +
    guides(
      colour = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(linewidth = 0.6)
      )
    ) + ggtitle(tit[k])
}
pdf("sim2_fit0_xi1est_2.pdf",height=5,width=10)
grid.arrange(l[[1]],l[[2]],l[[3]],l[[4]],l[[5]],l[[6]],
             l[[7]],l[[8]],l[[9]],l[[10]],l[[11]],l[[12]],
             l[[13]],l[[14]],l[[15]],ncol=5,nrow=3)
dev.off()
```
